title: Encoding the initial arithmetic state
statement: For every bit string $z$, the initial word constructed from $z$ equals the encoding of the arithmetic state whose rows are obtained by decoding the second component of $z$ into words and then entries, reducing each entry modulo the natural-number value of the first component of $z$. The state’s remaining parameters are $1$, the number of its rows, and $0$, and the encoded state uses the natural-number value of that first component as its parameter.
